sentences.en: The Fengshan basin is a well - preserved extensional basin in the Yanshan structural belt.

sentences.en: Dayangshu Basin was in extensional setting in the Quaternary period, and a series of small extensional half-grabens were formed.

sentences.en: The main mechanism of melt lineation is extensional deformation which led to partial melting of high-grade metamorphic rock.
